title: Pete Lala's band: Joe Oliver, Old Man Valto, Palao
summary: Amacker lists who played in the band at Pete Lala's, including Oliver, Valto, Jimmy Palao and Will Elfrey.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: Pete Lala's that band, you say it had Joe Oliver and Old Man Valto?

Yeah, it had Joe Oliver and Old Man Valto. Who else was there? Old Man Valto was there for a while, and then, let me see, there was, Jimmy Pallow was there for a while. You heard talking about Jimmy Pallow? Did you hear Jimmy Pallow? He was a violinist, Jimmy Pallow was, you know. He was there for a while. Old Man Valto, he played violin there for a long time. Will Elfrey, tell him Will Elfrey. I know him. Do you know Will Elfrey? I don't mean the son.
Do you know the old man?

Oh, you know the old man too? Yeah. Well, I'll be damned until you see you know them all then, don't you? Yeah. I'm trying my best to get you and I can't do it. Shit, I can't get you today, can I? You know them all.
